system.description: The stenhinje can take the form of a simple object (such as a chest, door, wall, or floor), made from its own mass. The GM decides what prompts it to attack, such as violence against it or the arrival of a specific enemy. It is almost impossible to recognise as a living creature without the appropriate vitner.
system.summary: Allows taking the appearance of a simple object.
